messages:
alex: Quick micro-poll — worst config screw-up you've seen that forced a revert? I nominate: published package with version '1' and CI weirdness. 

nina: YAML indentation won once. helm broke because someone mixed a tab into values.yaml :sob: 

calvin: Not exactly glamorous but had `package.json` with "version: 0.1" (no semver patch) and our deploy matcher refused to tag. Took down the rollout.

jen: Compiler tantrom I remember:
```
error[E0308]: mismatched types
 --> src/main.rs:42:13
  |
42 |     let s: &str = format!("v{}", ver);
   |             ^^^ expected &str, found struct `std::string::String`

note: you probably meant to use `let s = format!(...)` or `format!(...).as_str()`
```

ci-bot: deploy-bot: CI report — lint failed: YAML parse error at values.yaml: line 18: found tab character; also package.json contains invalid semver 'one.two'.

alex: Okay new poll format: react with :one: :two: :three: :four:
1) Bad semver/version parsing
2) YAML tabs/indentation
3) `image: latest` / wrong Docker tag
4) Surprise compiler errors at runtime

nina: :two: all the way. Had to rollback an entire chart because of one tab.

calvin: :one: guilty. We once pushed a hotfix that bumped version to `v1` and the rollout system ignored it.

jen: :four: compiler tantrums haunt my dreams. Also sometimes `// TODO: fix later` becomes prod feature :pray:

alex: Also shoutout to whoever sneaks `env: STAGE=production` into the config at 3am. Not naming names. :eyes:

ci-bot: reminder: run `npm version --no-git-tag-version 1.0.1` or use proper semver to avoid deploy matcher issues.

alex: I'm compiling a tiny 'Config Hall of Shame' slide for onboarding — votes and short anecdotes welcome. Keep them short, we want painful but funny ones. :laughing:
